evidence.detail: Repository HEAD exactly matches the launcher-supplied target commit.
The target record exists and identifies roadmap v5 as DRAFT awaiting Codex review and human approval.
Roadmap v5 introduces ISSUE-0014 as its only forward-looking implementation item, but no project/issues/ISSUE-0014.md work-item record exists.
The current-state record names an older roadmap candidate SHA rather than the commit under review.
Governance validation could not complete because the read-only environment provided no usable temporary directory; it failed before producing validation results.

evidence: ROADMAP.md:312 marks ISSUE-0014 PLANNED and supplies only a compact table row.
ROADMAP.md:327 defines path boundaries for ISSUE-0014.
project/status/CURRENT.md:225 makes approval and a separate start decision prerequisites for ISSUE-0014.
There is no project/issues/ISSUE-0014.md, although AGENTS.md requires review of all proposed work items and the repository uses individual work-item records for ISSUE-0001 through ISSUE-0013.

Without the issue record, the plan lacks the normal fields needed to bind implementation: issue status, starting SHA/branch, complete acceptance criteria, verification evidence requirements, risks, documentation obligations, and closeout requirements.
findings.remediation: Add project/issues/ISSUE-0014.md using the repository work-item template, binding it to M3 and roadmap v5. Carry over the roadmap objective, dependencies, allowed paths, exclusions, checks, documentation, risk treatment, and separate human start gate. Define commit-bound evidence and closeout requirements explicitly.
findings.title: The only proposed implementation item has no reviewable work-item record
findings.verification: Confirm project/issues/ISSUE-0014.md exists, is linked from the roadmap/current status as appropriate, passes repository governance validation, and contains enough bounded acceptance and verification detail for a fresh issue task to reconstruct its exact authority and scope.

evidence: The launcher binds this review to HEAD 441b4da0d3ba0d9d13dcf0d710bdae5a1c0685ab.
project/status/CURRENT.md:207 instead calls ef2ea6d318e5d5ac46bd0953a96daa8cdb782e7c the roadmap-v5 candidate now being reviewed.
AGENTS.md requires CURRENT.md to link current-gate evidence and identify the reviewed candidate accurately.
findings.remediation: Update the ROADMAP_REVIEW stage record to identify 441b4da0d3ba0d9d13dcf0d710bdae5a1c0685ab as the exact plan-review candidate, or clearly distinguish the earlier drafting commit from the current review-bound commit.
findings.title: Current-state record binds the active roadmap review to a stale candidate SHA
findings.verification: At the next review commit, compare git rev-parse HEAD with the exact candidate SHA named in project/status/CURRENT.md and confirm they match.

evidence: ROADMAP.md:312 requires proving that a deliberately red frontend test fails the GitHub workflow by observation.

The criterion does not specify the authorized branch/target, how the deliberate failure is introduced without contaminating the candidate, what GitHub Actions evidence must be recorded, or how cleanup is handled.
AGENTS.md treats external publication and destructive Git/branch cleanup as protected actions requiring exact human approval.
findings.remediation: In ISSUE-0014's work-item record, define a safe verification procedure for the negative CI test: exact disposable branch or equivalent mechanism, required separate authorization for push/cleanup, expected failing job/step, evidence to retain, restoration procedure, and the final clean candidate checks. If no external run is authorized, replace this criterion with a locally executable workflow-validation test that proves failure propagation without claiming GitHub-hosted execution.
findings.title: The negative CI acceptance test depends on unspecified protected external actions
findings.verification: Execute the documented procedure under exact human authorization and retain the failing run identity/output plus a subsequent clean run for the final candidate, or run the approved local failure-propagation test and record its real output.

evidence: ROADMAP.md:421 records RISK-009 as a new medium build-time supply-chain risk with no human acceptance.
project/milestones/M3.md:146 explicitly asks whether the risk is accepted or requires pinning/auditing work beyond ISSUE-0014.
ISSUE-0014 currently adds npm ci/build/test but does not add dependency auditing or broader supply-chain controls.
findings.remediation: The human must choose and record one exact treatment before roadmap approval: accept RISK-009 with owner/review date and its stated gaps, or expand/add a bounded work item for the selected audit/pinning controls and make it a dependency of the M3 gate.
findings.title: RISK-009 requires an explicit human treatment decision
findings.verification: Verify a human-authored decision binds the exact roadmap commit and either records precise residual-risk acceptance or links acceptance criteria for the chosen additional mitigation work.

limitations: Repository history is grafted at the reviewed HEAD, so earlier commit relationships and historical tree identity could not be independently traversed in this checkout.
Governance validation did not complete because no writable temporary directory was available in the read-only review environment; this is missing check evidence, not a product finding by itself.

No npm install, frontend build, frontend test, or GitHub Actions execution was attempted: dependency installation is protected, the environment is read-only/network-restricted, and this was a roadmap review rather than candidate implementation verification.

The approved brief predates M3 and explicitly retains the old no-Node/no-build constraint; roadmap v5 candidly states that M3 has no governing brief section and relies on DECISION-024, so this review assessed that exception as recorded rather than treating the brief as retroactively amended.
review.summary: Roadmap v5 is not ready for approval. Target identity is valid, but the only forward-looking issue lacks its required work-item record, CURRENT.md names a stale review candidate, the proposed negative CI verification leaves protected external actions undefined, and the new medium npm supply-chain risk still needs an exact human treatment decision.
